entities.name: Query L-carnitine antiporter
observations: 504-aa highly hydrophobic BCCT-family multipass membrane protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P59334.
Curated annotation identifies exchange of L-carnitine and gamma-butyrobetaine across the bacterial inner membrane.
Sequence-derived molecular mass is approximately 56.3 kDa; Pfam BCCT domain PF02028 spans residues 14–499.

entities.name: RHEA:29427
observations: This is coupled substrate exchange across the membrane, not a covalent chemical transformation.

entities.name: P59334
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Proteus sp. LE138; exact sequence hash match to the query.
Function: L-carnitine/gamma-butyrobetaine antiporter; localization: cell inner membrane; subunit: homotrimer.
